facts.label: Hotel online
facts.sub: Use there is com uma coisa e there are com várias. Pergunte How many rooms are there? para números e How much is it? para preço.

facts.label: Há (um)
facts.sub: Use there is para uma coisa só: There is a pool. There is a balcony. Na pergunta, a ordem muda: Is there a pool? A resposta curta é Yes, there is ou No, there isn’t.

facts.label: Há (vários)
facts.sub: Use there are para duas ou mais coisas: There are two beds. There are three rooms. Na pergunta, diga Are there towels? Resposta curta: Yes, there are.

compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “tem um quarto” e “tem dois quartos”.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.why: There are goes with many things.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.

There are + one thing. → Falso (There are goes with many things.)
How many asks about numbers. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A living room · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a cold evening in Montreal. Kara and Lia sit on the sofa. Kara has a laptop on her knees. They plan a trip for next month. They look at hotels on the screen. Kara starts to talk.
“Hi, Lia! Look, there are many hotels in Montreal.” says Kara. “How many rooms are there near the river?” says Lia. “There are three rooms. There is one with a balcony.” says Kara.
